name: Parley
summary: Desktop app that records both sides of calls, transcribes and analyzes them with user-configured AI providers, and exposes the library via a local MCP server.
use_cases: transcribe both sides of a sales call live
get a debrief with commitments and action items after a meeting
dictate text into any app with push-to-talk
features: live diarized transcription of both call sides
local MCP server exposing meeting library

capabilities.label: Record both sides of a call
Bring your own STT and LLM providers
Live coach feed with evaluation alerts
Replay and re-run analysis at any point
Let external AI own the analysis

runtimes: Bun or Node.js, for building from source

findings.summary: zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Leading to Arbitrary File Overwrite & RCE
ZipStreamReader::extract() and ZipArchive::extract() apply Unix permissions through symlinks without confining the target

evidence: the project's source does not use ZipStreamReader::extract, ZipArchive::extract, but other packages depend on zip

findings.summary: Quadratic run time when checking a start tag for duplicate attribute names
Unbounded namespace-declaration allocation in `NsReader` enables memory-exhaustion denial of service

evidence: the project's source does not use NsReader, but other packages depend on quick-xml

findings.summary: zip: Unbounded Symlink-Target Handling Can Abort Or Exhaust Memory During Extraction
Insecure Preservation of SUID/SGID Bits during ZIP Extraction Leading to Potential Privilege Escalation
@fastify/busboy vulnerable to Denial of Service via prototype-named multipart part header
brace-expansion: DoS via exponential-time expansion of consecutive non-expanding {} groups
brace-expansion: DoS via uncontrolled recursion in parseCommaParts causing stack exhaustion
brace-expansion: DoS via unbounded expansion length causing an out-of-memory process crash
brace-expansion: DoS via uncontrolled recursion on nested brace groups causing stack exhaustion

Browserslist: Unbounded memory growth (no cache eviction) via distinct query results, leading to eventual OOM
fast-uri vulnerable to host confusion via failed IDN canonicalization
fast-uri vulnerable to host confusion via backslash authority introducer
fast-uri vulnerable to server-side request forgery via malformed IPv6 normalization
fast-uri vulnerable to server-side request forgery via repeated hostname percent-decoding
fast-uri vulnerable to host confusion via percent-encoded scheme normalization
fast-uri vulnerable to authority injection via an unvalidated port in serialize
proxy-addr vulnerable to IP spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust subnet

what_it_does.quote: Parley does four things: **record, transcribe, analyze, search**. It captures both sides of a call, gives you a speaker-labelled transcript live, writes a debrief when the meeting ends

who_it_is_for.quote: Real-time AI coaching for sales & negotiation calls

prerequisites.quote: Then paste your API keys in **Settings**: one STT provider for transcription, one LLM for analysis and Ask.

first_run_example.quote: claude mcp add --transport http parley http://127.0.0.1:3011/mcp

config_and_keys.quote: Then paste your API keys in **Settings**: one STT provider for transcription, one LLM for analysis and Ask. Or sign in and use the hosted providers with no key to manage.

troubleshooting_uninstall.quote: The installer is not code-signed, so SmartScreen shows an "unknown publisher" warning: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
